subject: 360 feedback rollup + successor readiness plan
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@zenlyhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Iqbal <samir.iqbal@zenlyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 manager coordination — 360 data and successor ask

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the prep call last week. As we kick off our quarterly check-ins next week, our leadership team asked for two things from Redwood: a consolidated 360 rollup for managers that includes themes and any high-risk notes, and a short successor-readiness snapshot for the two ICs potentially moving into the Sr. Eng role on the platform team.

We realize some of this is sensitive, so Samir and I wanted to confirm a secure channel and a deadline: can you share a manager-level summary and the successor-readiness one-pager by Thursday EOD (2027-01-14)? If there are any items that require HR redaction, flag them and we can route through our people ops.

Deliverable guidance from our side:
- One consolidated 360 summary (2 pages max) highlighting recurring behavior themes, calibration flags, and anonymized quotes.
- Successor-readiness one-pager per candidate (strengths, gaps, readiness level).
- Raw responses as a CSV for audit if needed.

We can accept everything via a shared Drive link or our secured SFTP. Let me know which you prefer.

Best,
Ellen
Director, People Ops
Zenly Health

[Attachment: zirconia_360_template_v2.xlsx (reference template)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@zenlyhealth.com>, Samir Iqbal <samir.iqbal@zenlyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 manager coordination — 360 data and successor ask

Team — forwarding Ellen's ask. High priority: Zenly wants a clean manager-facing rollup + candidate readiness pages by Thu EOD. Sensitive material; mark anything that might need HR redaction. Proposed plan below.

Plan (owner / ETA):
- Pull raw 360 responses and anonymize (Neha) — deliver CSV + anonymization mapping to me for internal audit by Wed 12pm.
- Draft two-page rollup with themes & anonymized quotes (Laura) — draft Wed 5pm, internal review Thurs 9am.
- Succession one-pagers for two candidates (Vivek) — template + completed pages Wed 6pm.
- Final assemble + export to Zenly Drive link (me) — Thu 1pm, then confirm any HR redactions.

Attachments I'm adding for context: 360_raw_responses.csv (raw), succession_candidate_notes.docx (internal notes, DO NOT SHARE), Q1_manager_guidance.pdf (internal guidance language). I will not upload the candidate_notes to the external Drive; will share the redacted one-pagers only.

Logistics: Ellen prefers Drive link. We'll use a restricted folder that only includes the deliverables (no raw/internal notes). If HR asks for raw data for audit, we'll coordinate via secure SFTP.

Please confirm owners and flag any blocking context (e.g., pending employee consent forms, active investigations).

Thanks — Logan
Logan Wright
VP, People & Org Effectiveness
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@zenlyhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 manager coordination — 360 data and successor ask

Thanks Logan — confirmed. Quick notes on the draft rollup approach:
- I will structure the rollup with three sections: (1) Cross-team themes, (2) Calibration flags (names redacted), (3) Suggested manager talking points.
- For anonymized quotes: I'll limit to verbatim one-liners and paraphrase the rest to avoid re-identification.
- There are two responses that contain explicit compensation questions — those should be excluded from the public rollup and routed to HR. Neha, can you flag those rows and add a short redaction note?

On succession pages: Vivek, please include a short risk matrix (3x3) and a 30/60/90 recommended support plan. I'll proof and add readiness commentary.

Edge case: Candidate B indicated they're open to a lateral move only — we should surface that as a readiness caveat.

I'll have the first draft up in the Drive folder by Wed 5pm. Sending offline notes to Logan.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, People Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 manager coordination — 360 data and successor ask

Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone — final status below.

Status update:
- Neha: anonymized CSV uploaded to our internal drive (linked in HR ticket). Two rows flagged for HR review (compensation questions).
- Laura: draft rollup v0.1 uploaded (Drive). Includes three themes and manager talking points.
- Vivek: two successor one-pagers completed; Candidate A = ready-with-support, Candidate B = ready-with-conditions (lateral preferred).
- I assembled the external folder and shared a Drive link with Ellen+Samir. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQ1_360-rollup

Next actions (by Zenly/Human Resources):
- Ellen: confirm receipt and let us know if you want further redactions or a sanitized raw export for audit (we can SFTP).
- Samir: if you want a short 15-min walkthrough of the rollup tomorrow, I can join.

If Zenly needs the internal candidate_notes, we'll route through your HR SFTP and log the transfer (HR-TICKET-4721).

Thanks — close loop once you confirm.

— Logan
